description: Same rule shape as shop_001: a rule yields `effect` when applies_if and all conditions hold, otherwise `else_effect`.

derived_facts.unpaid_invoices: 1 if the latest past-due invoice is not fully paid, else 0
derived_facts.paid_invoices: count of invoices with status paid or paid_late
derived_facts.charge_confirmed_wrong: transactions.is_duplicate = 1 or a confirmed system error

rules.quote: A bundle subscribed by mistake is refunded in full if it is cancelled within 24 hours

user_message.ar: للأسف استرداد الباقة متاح خلال 24 ساعة بس من الاشتراك والمدة دي عدت.
user_message.en: Bundle refunds are only possible within 24 hours of subscribing, and that time has passed.

rules.quote: and less than 5% of it was used

user_message.ar: للأسف اتستخدم أكتر من 5% من الباقة فمش هقدر أرجع قيمتها.
user_message.en: More than 5% of the bundle has been used, so it can't be refunded.

rules.quote: Customer service can approve such refunds up to 200 EGP per case; above that a supervisor must approve.

user_message.ar: المبلغ أكبر من 200 جنيه فمحتاج موافقة مشرف، هحول الطلب له.
user_message.en: The amount is over 200 EGP, so a supervisor needs to approve it. I'm passing it on.

rules.quote: If system records confirm a charge was wrong or duplicated, the full amount is returned

user_message.ar: مش لاقي في السجلات إن الخصم ده غلط أو متكرر، هحولك لزميل يراجعه.
user_message.en: The records don't show this charge as wrong or duplicated; I'll pass it to a colleague to review.

rules.quote: are refunded for up to the last 30 days

user_message.ar: الاسترداد بيكون عن آخر 30 يوم بس.
user_message.en: Refunds cover the last 30 days at most.

rules.quote: A customer may dispute any charge within 60 days of the bill date.

user_message.ar: الاعتراض متاح خلال 60 يوم من تاريخ الفاتورة والمدة دي عدت.
user_message.en: Disputes must be raised within 60 days of the invoice date, and that has passed.

rules.quote: adjustments above 500 EGP need a supervisor

user_message.ar: المبلغ أكبر من 500 جنيه فهحول الاعتراض لمشرف.
user_message.en: The amount is over 500 EGP, so I'm passing the dispute to a supervisor.

rules.quote: if they have owned the line for at least 4 months

user_message.ar: نقل الرقم متاح بعد 4 شهور من ملكية الخط.
user_message.en: Porting out is possible once you have owned the line for 4 months.

rules.quote: and the latest bill is paid

user_message.ar: لازم تسدد آخر فاتورة الأول قبل نقل الرقم.
user_message.en: The latest bill must be paid before porting out.

rules.quote: SIM replacement is never done through chat or phone.

user_message.ar: بدل الفاقد بيتعمل في الفرع بس بالبطاقة الأصلية.
user_message.en: A SIM replacement is only done in a store with the original national ID.

rules.quote: Chat agents can explain the steps but cannot cancel a line.

user_message.ar: إلغاء الخط بيكون من الفرع بس.
user_message.en: Lines are cancelled in a store only.

rules.quote: When balance is below 5 EGP, customers can borrow

user_message.ar: سلفني متاحة لما الرصيد يكون أقل من 5 جنيه.
user_message.en: Salefny is available when your balance is under 5 EGP.

rules.quote: Only one Salefny can be outstanding at a time.

user_message.ar: عليك سلفة لسه متسددتش، أول ما تشحن هتقدر تتسلف تاني.
user_message.en: You still have an unpaid Salefny; once your next recharge repays it you can borrow again.

rules.quote: Postpaid roaming is free to activate once the line has paid 4 bills, or earlier with a 750 EGP roaming deposit.

user_message.ar: خطك لسه مسددش 4 فواتير، فتفعيل التجوال محتاج تأمين 750 جنيه، هحولك لزميل يكمل معاك.
user_message.en: Your line hasn't paid 4 bills yet, so roaming needs a 750 EGP deposit. I'll pass you to a colleague to arrange it.

rules.quote: Postpaid plan changes are allowed once per billing cycle

user_message.ar: غيرت النظام مرة في الدورة دي بالفعل، تقدر تغيره تاني من الدورة الجاية.
user_message.en: You already changed plan this cycle; you can change again next cycle.

rules.quote: The price is taken from balance (prepaid)

user_message.en: Your balance isn't enough for this bundle.

user_message.ar: التعويض بيكون للأعطال اللي أكتر من 24 ساعة متصلة.
user_message.en: Compensation applies to outages longer than 24 continuous hours.

rules.quote: between 1 and 50 EGP of credit per transfer

user_message.ar: التحويل من 1 لـ 50 جنيه في المرة.

rules.quote: The PUK code is given only to the verified line owner

user_message.ar: لازم أتأكد إنك صاحب الخط الأول.
user_message.en: I need to verify you're the line owner first.
